changes.title: Book a repair visit from a phone.
changes.text: The current homepage has no request form. The sketch puts a Request a repair visit button right under the headline.

changes.title: Tap to call at the top.
changes.text: Your number is in the header and in a large button, so someone with a broken fridge can reach you in one tap.

changes.title: Your $10 coupon up front.
changes.text: The online coupon for $10 off a service repair call gets its own card instead of sitting low on the page.
